svg.text: CRYSTALLOGRAPHIC EVOLUTION: TURBOSTRATIC CARBON TO BERNAL ABAB LATTICE
Atomic-Scale Phase Transition (1,000 -> 3,000 °C): d002 Contraction, Mering-Maire Graphitization & Stage-1 LiC6 Intercalation
BASIS: 1,000 kg FINISHED cSPG (24,300 kg ROM ORE)
CAD SECTION VIEW A-A | P&ID INSTRUMENTED

g.text: A. SIDE VIEW (c-AXIS): WAVY, CROSS-LINKED GRAPHENE RIBBONS
Steric bottleneck: high Li+ diffusion barrier (E_a > 0.65 eV)
B. BASAL PLAN VIEW: MOIRE TWIST
Stacking height L_c = 2 - 5 nm | In-plane domain L_a = 4 - 10 nm
High D-band (1,350 cm-1) defect intensity: I_D / I_G = 0.85 - 1.25
180 - 230 mAh/g (Sloping voltage curve, high hysteresis, no LiC6 plateau)
2. BERNAL HEXAGONAL 2H GRAPHITE: ORDERED ABAB REGISTRY (2,800 - 3,000 °C)
A. SIDE VIEW (c-AXIS): ABAB STACKING & STAGE-1 LiC6 GALLERIES
Stage-1 LiC6: rapid 2D Li+ diffusion (D_Li ~ 10^-8 cm2/s) -> 372 mAh/g
B. BASAL PLAN VIEW: ABAB + LiC6
Layer B shifted by a_C-C = 0.1421 nm
P6_3/mmc (2H Hexagonal ABAB Bernal registry; <10% 3R ABC rhombohedral)
Stacking height L_c = 25 - 45 nm | In-plane domain L_a = 50 - 120 nm
Dominant G-band (1,580 cm-1) sp2 stretching: I_D / I_G = 0.08 - 0.22
355 - 365 mAh/g (95-98% of 372 mAh/g Stage-1 LiC6 theoretical limit)
MERING-MAIRE GRAPHITIZATION TRAJECTORY (d002 VS. T) & DAUMAS-HEROLD Li+ STAGING
A. INTERLAYER CONTRACTION d002(T) & MERING-MAIRE g
Threshold: T >= 2,500 °C required to reach g >= 88%.
B. Li+ STAGING POTENTIAL PROFILE (V vs. Li/Li+)
Ordered ABAB galleries fill sequentially (LiC36 -> LiC12 -> LiC6)
at 0.20 - 0.08 V vs Li/Li+, maximizing cell voltage & energy.
Why Natural cSPG Uses 42.6% Less Electricity Than Acheson Synthetic Graphite:
• 1. Natural Flake Route (7.91 kWh/kg cSPG): Geological metamorphism (700-850 °C, 5-8 kbar
over ~10^7 yr) provides d002 = 0.3354 nm (g ~ 100%) for free; only the 5 wt% amorphous
• 2. Synthetic Route (13.79 kWh/kg Acheson | 8.69 kWh/kg LWG): Must overcome the
260 kJ/mol C-C rearrange activation barrier at 2,800-3,000 °C to convert turbostratic
needle coke (d002 = 0.3440 nm) into ABAB graphite (d002 = 0.3356 nm, g = 93-97%).
• Trade-Off: Synthetic has lower swelling & longer cycle life (>2,000 cycles vs ~1,200 natural).
TURBOSTRATIC TO BERNAL ABAB CRYSTAL LATTICE
AUDIT METRICS: d002: >=0.3440 nm (g=0%) -> 0.3354 nm (g>93%) | Stage-1 LiC6: 372 mAh/g
PRIMARY PROVENANCE: Franklin (1951); Surovtseva et al. (2022); ANL-22/74
